prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: cinematic editorial studio photograph for Quadem Digital's homepage hero, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: Create a striking, premium creative-studio scene based on Quadem's actual work. This replaces a flat, dark generic laptop mockup. It must feel like a beautifully art-directed photograph, with a clear focal point, rich material detail, warm practical lighting and dramatic depth.
Input images: 1 is the CURRENT Omek website screenshot, to insert faithfully into the main desktop display. 2 is the QuajoSpeaks website screenshot, to insert faithfully into a smaller open laptop screen. 3 is Quadem's actual identity artwork: use its existing QD logo and navy/blue printed stationery, do not invent a replacement logo.
Scene/backdrop: an intimate independent creative studio at blue hour. A substantial walnut workbench runs diagonally into the frame. Deep midnight-blue wall, warm amber side light through a tall window on the far right, subtle cyan reflected screen light, tactile wood and brushed metal. A restrained, softly out-of-focus glimpse of tropical foliage outside, not an identifiable office.
Composition: Deliberately reserve the LEFT 40% as calm very dark navy negative space for live HTML headline and CTA; no text, bright highlights or foreground objects in that left area. ALL focal subjects occupy the RIGHT 60%. The main large, slim professional display is the hero object, centered around 73% across and 43% down, with the entire current Omek page visible, sharp and vivid. It is angled only slightly for credible perspective. The smaller laptop sits below and forward around 72% across and 74% down, displaying QuajoSpeaks. A compact professional video camera and a single navy Quadem brand folder sit neatly near the lower right of the workbench, supporting the story of websites, brand and content. Keep objects carefully composed, not scattered. Make the screens large enough to recognize their actual design. Leave the top 10% dark and quiet for site navigation.
Lighting/mood: the screen faces are crisp and luminous, the wood and metal have golden edge lighting, a beautiful diagonal band of warm evening light enters from the right. Strong separation of foreground, midground and background. Sophisticated cinematic contrast without crushing the actual work into darkness. Natural photographic grain, 35mm editorial photography, real lenses and plausible physical proportions.
Constraints: Use the supplied actual website designs, colors, logos and visible headings on the two screens. Omek is the dominant screen, QuajoSpeaks secondary. Preserve the QD mark on the stationery. No invented charts, revenue claims, client names or website interfaces. No floating abstract 3D shapes, no sci-fi neon tubes, no robot imagery, no extra screens, no people, no stock-office clutter. No added title/caption/watermark outside the screens and stationery. The image is a conceptual AI-assisted studio presentation, not evidence of a real Quadem office. Output one finished photographic asset.
